## Report View

How a statement is read, saved on its card: `basis` (accrual or cash), `columns` (total only, months, quarters, classes, or customer or vendor) and `compare` (none, the previous period, or the previous year). An empty setting reads as accrual, total only, no comparison.

```ts
import { ReportView, ReportViewControls, viewOf, accrualEntries, cashEntries, netByColumn } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-report-settings';
```

`ReportViewControls` shows the three choices above a statement and saves them on its card.

Profit and loss takes all three. A plain accrual total reads the closed months' snapshots as before. Any other view reads each posting: the journal months, and the invoices, bills and opening balances still posted as cards. On the cash basis an invoice's or bill's lines count on the day a payment is applied to it, in the share paid, and credit memos, write-offs, vendor credits and voids don't count.

The balance sheet takes columns by month or quarter end within its fiscal year, and a comparison. The trial balance takes a comparison. Both are accrual.

### Non-goals
No cash-basis balance sheet. No filters yet. Cash basis follows payments posted to the journal, the way the example books keep them.

### Example
`Reports/pnl-2026-quarters`, `Reports/pnl-2026-h2-cash`, `Reports/balance-sheet-2026-12-quarters`.
